styles: pulsing analog sub bass ostinato in 16th notes

chunks.name: Pulse
chunks.text: {starts immediately on beat 1 with a low pulse hit and the sub ostinato, no fade in, tense and dark}

chunks.name: Build
chunks.text: {tension rises steadily, percussion intensifies, the pulse doubles and the riser climbs to the very end, last half bar cuts to silence}

chunks.name: Hit
chunks.text: {one massive unison hit with sub drop on beat 1, then no more drums, only the dark tail ringing out to silence}
